rechecks.result: The official 14 July 2026 changelog and release repository identify Codex CLI 0.144.4 as latest. Local 0.144.3 is intentionally not updated.
W3C Verifiable Credential Data Integrity 1.0 remains a 15 May 2025 Recommendation; Data Integrity 1.1 remains a draft and is not promoted.
W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 remains the stable Recommendation; v2.1 remains draft.
ICH E9(R1) remains the Step 4 estimands and sensitivity-analysis anchor.
Unicode Technical Standard 39 revision 32 is the approved Unicode 17.0.0 security-mechanisms reference; proposed updates remain non-stable.

draft_and_watch_preservation: All inherited draft and watch labels remain visible and cannot replace stable pins without a future source review.
